packageRules.description: AUTH-08 and SITE-06: Better Auth and TanStack Start have shipped security fixes within days of a release. Their pull requests open at once and carry a label. A fix that is younger than seven days needs the manual fast path in docs/releasing.md.
SEC-13: the SHA of a GitHub Action is updated together with the tag in its comment, and a release of an action is still held for seven days.
